set.body:
Journey: Open. Track: console and engine.

Outcome
A steward sees exactly what stands between a frozen study and publication, and fixes each item in place.

Acceptance
1. A Publish section on the study page lists checks for the chosen release. Each one passes, fails, or needs a person:
   - Description: Name, Authors and a README longer than a stub; Funding, EthicsApprovals and HowToAcknowledge where they apply.
   - Licence: present and one of the allowed values (OPEN0).
   - Structure: no error findings in Sanctity. The official BIDS validator runs when the package is built (OPEN2).
   - Dictionaries: participants.json is present; every phenotype table has a dictionary; columns without a description are listed.
   - De-identification, automatic: no sidecar fields from a deny list (PatientName, PatientBirthDate, AcquisitionDateTime and the like); no date-like columns in participant tables; ages above 89 flagged; sourcedata/ excluded from the package.
   - De-identification, attested: structural images defaced (tool and date); free-text columns reviewed; consent and the ethics protocol permit open release. Each attestation records who made it and when.
2. Each failing check links to its fix: the correction editor for that file, or the attestation form.
3. Attestations are a small file in the dataset, sourcedata/sanctity/publication-readiness.json, added through the normal correction flow. The acceptance record shows who attested and when. The file is left out of the public package.
4. Readiness is computed from the release itself by one server read, used by both the console and the publishing tool. It is therefore bound to that exact release, and every steward sees the same answer. There is no new stored state.

Not in scope
Defacing images. Automatic face detection. Minting DOIs.

Start from
- The study page from SEE4.
- The correction flow in modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js, correctionView.
- modules/bids/src/main/scala/sanctity/bids/ArchiveInterpreter.scala line 91: the License and DatasetDOI fields.

Evidence
Console checks with one failing and one passing fixture. The OPEN5 rehearsal.
set.title: OPEN1: Publication readiness checklist on the study page
